scenario.task:
I want to check my balance by entering my phone number and security PIN using my telephone keypad.

User Guide: Speak in English. When the agent asks for your phone number, say: "I'm typing it on the keypad: 5 1 4 5 5 5 0 1 9 9". When the agent requests identity verification, enter your PIN on the keypad: "I'm entering my PIN on the keypad: 4 8 2 9". Ask for your current account balance.
